label: RUNX1::CBFA2T3

sections.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis.
CBFA2T3 encodes a transcriptional corepressor involved in hematopoietic differentiation.
The t(16;21)(q24;q22) fusion combines RUNX1 DNA binding with a CBFA2T3 corepressor region, altering myeloid transcription. Its expression profile resembles RUNX1::RUNX1T1 AML.
In the pediatric I-BFM cohort, outcomes resembled other core-binding factor leukemias and were substantially better than those of FUS::ERG AML.
